The main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.

The sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of violet and burnt orange as it bled into the churning ocean. Clara stood motionless on the weathered dock, the salt spray misting her cheeks. In her hands, she clutched the old, tattered hat she had found in the attic—her father's. The brim was frayed, the felt soft from years of wear, but to her, it was a relic of a different world. Each fiber seemed to carry a memory, a piece of laughter, a whisper of song, from a time before grief had wrapped its cold fingers around her family. She pressed the hat to her chest, closing her eyes, trying to breathe in the ghost of his presence, hoping that somewhere in the fading light, he was still there, watching over her.
